description: After sending an application to a posting from find_jobs, or failing to, report the outcome: sent, uncertain (submitted, but the board neither confirmed nor clearly refused it), failed (with the reason) or handed over to the person to send. Nothing about the person is asked or stored; it counts which postings get applications and where sending gets stuck, so the site can fix it.

browser.description: What you sent it with: built_in (your client's own browser), claude_in_chrome, playwright_mcp, other, or none.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the goal in general terms, and refer to people by role ("a candidate") rather than by name. Leave out personal and identifying information.

notes.description: In a sentence or two, what you had to work out that these tools did not tell you: the tool or trick that worked, what the board did. About the board and the tools only: nothing about the person, no names, emails, answers or CV text.

reason.description: Why it failed or is uncertain: captcha, login_required, form_error (a field was refused), upload_refused (the board would not take the CV file), submit_error (the board answered the submit with an error), no_confirmation (submitted, nothing confirmed it), posting_closed, blocked (the board refused the browser), no_browser, person_declined, other (say what in notes).

status.description: sent: the board confirmed it, on the page or by email. uncertain: it was submitted and the board showed an error or no confirmation, so it may or may not have arrived. failed: it was not submitted. handed_over: the person got the URL and the answers.

steps.description: What it took beyond filling the form, every one that applies: set_up_browser (you had to add a browser tool), switched_browser (the first tool failed and another worked), read_form_in_browser (job_questions gave no questions), extra_questions (the page asked ones job_questions did not list), required_differed (the page required a field given as optional, or the reverse), location_differed (the page named another location), reattached_cv (the upload had to be repeated), converted_cv (the board wanted another file format or size), email_code, captcha_to_person, person_signed_in (an account or login), person_filled_field (they typed something you could not), retried_submit, other.

name: report_application
title: Report how an application went
